facts.statement: A new prize wheel was added for the Festival of Hearts; players could log in daily for new prizes.
facts.quote: A new prize wheel has been added in honor of the Festival of Hearts!  Log in daily for new prizes!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: Update notes for February 12, 2010 announcing the Festival of Hearts event in Merry Vale, with a daily prize wheel, a Coin Wheel for players logged in 30+ minutes a day, and Member benefits (doubled coin rewards during Power Hour, 10% Marketplace discount). It also lists new Marketplace items (pink penguin, pink Unicorn, She-Rex) and a TCG bundle that includes a pet redeem card.
